name: Hugging Face Chat UI
description: Chat UI is the open-source chat interface that powers HuggingChat. It works with any OpenAI-compatible API, such as Hugging Face Inference Providers, Ollama, llama.cpp or OpenRouter, and lists the models the endpoint offers. Conversations, settings and uploaded files are stored in MongoDB.

app_vars.name: var_openai_base_url
app_vars.label: OpenAI-compatible API base URL
app_vars.help: Any OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint, e.g. http://<ollama-host>:11434/v1. Can be changed later in /opt/huggingface-chat-ui.env

app_vars.name: var_openai_api_key
app_vars.label: API key
app_vars.help: Leave empty if the endpoint needs no key

notes.text: Open https://<IP> and accept the self-signed certificate.
To change the model provider, edit OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY in /opt/huggingface-chat-ui.env, then run systemctl restart huggingface-chat-ui.
There is no login by default: anyone who can reach the container can chat using your API key. Configure OpenID in /opt/huggingface-chat-ui.env to require sign-in.
